clients.doc: The per-invocation context the shim passes to the handler.

methods.name: log
methods.signature: log(*args: object) -> None
methods.doc: Structured log line → stdout (collected by the platform, ADR-0010).

methods.name: invoke
methods.signature: invoke(alias: str, payload: Any) -> Any
methods.doc: Synchronously invoke a linked function by its spec.bindings.links alias (ADR-0064). An object *payload* with a top-level ``"data"`` or ``"specversion"`` key is taken as a full CloudEvent envelope (ADR-0134): the target's ``event["data"]`` is only its ``data`` value, without the other keys. Send an object that has its own ``data`` key as ``{"specversion": "1.0", "data": payload}``.

methods.name: remaining_ms
methods.signature: remaining_ms() -> int | None
methods.doc: Milliseconds left before the call's deadline (X-Funcd-Timeout-Ms), floored at 0; None without one.

clients.name: kv
clients.doc: The key-value tables that the function binds, by alias: read, write and list their keys.

methods.name: get
methods.signature: get(binding: str, key: str) -> bytes | None
methods.doc: The key's value as bytes, or ``None`` when the key does not exist.

methods.name: get_entry
methods.signature: get_entry(binding: str, key: str) -> KVEntry | None
methods.doc: The key's value with its version, or ``None`` when the key does not exist.

methods.name: get_str
methods.signature: get_str(binding: str, key: str) -> str | None
methods.doc: The key's value decoded as UTF-8 text, or ``None`` when the key does not exist.

methods.name: get_json
methods.signature: get_json(binding: str, key: str) -> object | None
methods.doc: The key's value parsed as JSON, or ``None`` when the key does not exist. Write it with ``put(binding, key, json.dumps(value))``.

methods.name: put
methods.signature: put(binding: str, key: str, value: bytes | str, *, ttl: int | None = None) -> None
methods.doc: Writes the value. ``ttl``, in whole seconds, sets the key's expiry; a put without it leaves the key with none. Only the table's owner can write.

methods.name: put_if_absent
methods.signature: put_if_absent(binding: str, key: str, value: bytes | str, *, ttl: int | None = None) -> str | None
methods.doc: Creates the key: its new version, or ``None`` when it exists (an expired key does not).

methods.name: compare_and_set
methods.signature: compare_and_set(binding: str, key: str, value: bytes | str, version: str, *, ttl: int | None = None) -> str | None
methods.doc: Replaces the key while it is at ``version``: its new version, or ``None`` when it is not.

methods.name: delete
methods.signature: delete(binding: str, key: str) -> None

methods.name: delete_if
methods.signature: delete_if(binding: str, key: str, version: str) -> bool
methods.doc: Deletes the key while it is at ``version``, as a lease holder releases what it holds: ``True`` when it did.

methods.name: list
methods.signature: list(binding: str, prefix: str = '') -> list[str]
methods.doc: The keys that start with ``prefix``; without a prefix, every key of the table.

clients.name: blob
clients.doc: Binding-scoped blob storage (ADR-0127): get/put/delete/list a bound prefix's objects, or mint a presigned URL — the blob twin of ``kv``.

methods.name: get
methods.signature: get(binding: str, key: str) -> bytes | None

methods.name: put
methods.signature: put(binding: str, key: str, data: bytes) -> None

methods.name: delete
methods.signature: delete(binding: str, key: str) -> None

methods.name: list
methods.signature: list(binding: str, prefix: str = '') -> list[str]

methods.name: signed_url
methods.signature: signed_url(binding: str, key: str, method: str = 'GET', expiry: str | None = None) -> str
methods.doc: Return a presigned external URL for the object. ``method`` is GET (read) / PUT / DELETE (write); a PUT/DELETE URL requires s3::write. ``expiry`` is a duration string such as ``"10m"`` or ``"1h30m"`` (funcd ADR-0198: units h, m, s, ms in that order, whole seconds from 1s to 168h); ``None`` takes the driver's default. The shim sends the string as given and funcd refuses a bad one with 400, raised here as ``RuntimeError``; a non-string ``expiry`` raises ``TypeError`` before any request.

clients.name: sql
clients.doc: The SQL databases a function binds (funcd ADR-0233): ``query`` reads, ``query_values`` keeps every column of a join, ``execute`` writes in one transaction. A write needs the database's owner or a writer role.

methods.name: query
methods.signature: query(alias: str, sql: str, params: SQLParams | None = None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]
methods.doc: Rows as dicts; with a duplicate column name the last one wins (``query_values`` keeps every column).

methods.name: query_values
methods.signature: query_values(alias: str, sql: str, params: SQLParams | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]
methods.doc: Rows as ``{"columns": [...], "values": [[...]]}``, as rqlite returns them: every column of a join is kept.

methods.name: execute
methods.signature: execute(alias: str, sql_or_statements: str | Sequence[SQLStatement], params: SQLParams | None = None) -> Any
methods.doc: One statement's ``{"rowsAffected", "lastInsertId"}`` (with ``columns`` and ``values`` for RETURNING), or the list of them for a batch of statements, which runs all or nothing.

clients.name: config
clients.doc: The keys of the ConfigMaps a function binds (funcd ADR-0245); a key a bound Secret overrides is a secret.

methods.signature: get(key: str) -> str | None

methods.signature: list() -> list[str]

clients.name: secret
clients.doc: The keys and values of the Secrets a function binds, read from funcd on every call (funcd ADR-0249).

methods.name: get
methods.signature: get(key: str) -> str | None

methods.name: list
methods.signature: list() -> list[str]

clients.name: lake
clients.doc: A bound lake's proxy URL and token, by spec.bindings.lake alias (funcd ADR-0245).
